**T-TEST**

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}
data("starwars")
my_data <- starwars %>% 
  select(sex,height) %>% 
  filter(sex %in%c("male","female")) %>% 
  drop_na(height) %>% 
  print()

```

Now conducting a T-test on the data

```{r}
t.test(height~sex, data=my_data)

```

```{r}
my_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=height))+
  geom_histogram(colour="brown", fill="black",bins=10)+
  facet_wrap(~sex)+
  theme_bw()

```

Investigating that there is a difference between the Males and the Females Heights

first let's split the male and female data

```{r}
male_data <-my_data %>% 
  filter(sex=="male") %>% 
  print()
```

Now for the female data

```{r}
female_data <- my_data %>% 
  filter(sex=="female") %>% 
  print()

```

Performing now a t-test

```{r}
t.test(x=male_data$height,y=female_data$height,paired=FALSE,conf.level=0.95,alternative="two.sided")

```
